variableDebt.name: leading/hero-body
variableDebt.reason: Tailwind's size-paired default leadings (28px on text-lg and text-xl) are not on the leading/* ratio ladder, and Desktop's leading-tight resolves to 24 x 1.25 = 30. Forcing these onto a ratio primitive would change the rendering.
